cases.title: The starter about AI agents
cases.question: How does Brad ship with AI agents?
cases.answer: Brad ships with AI agents through a system built around review, locks and a single audited release path. The system around them is: docs every agent reads before it starts, one isolated checkout per agent, tests the coding agent can't rewrite, a second agent that reviews its work, a gate and a kill switch on every new feature, and one audited door to production, with evals and alerts feeding back into what gets built next. Releases are a separate, pinned step. Merging to master deploys nothing. Most new features reach production turned off, so merging and deploying code doesn't change what customers see.

cases.title: The starter about AI features
cases.question: What AI features has Brad shipped?
cases.answer:
Brad has shipped AI features on VINDecoded and at Hopper.

On VINDecoded, Brad shipped production AI features: grounded streaming vehicle chat, with provider-switchable models and tool-isolated vehicle data, and vision-based VIN, plate and gas-receipt scanning with structured outputs. Quotas, credits, kill switches, evals and PostHog/Sentry observability guard both.

At Hopper, Brad worked directly with the CEO, revenue leaders and the Fintech VP to launch a flight-shopping assistant and generative offers that matched or exceeded static-offer attach rates.

cases.title: From the essay: features ship dark
cases.question: In Brad’s essay, how do new features reach customers?
cases.answer: New features reach customers through a staged process. Most new features reach production turned off, so merging and deploying code doesn't change what customers see. Turning it on is a separate, deliberate step that takes effect in seconds and can be undone the same way. The steps are: Merged dark. The code ships behind a gate that is off for everyone. Then On for my account. I switch it on for myself in production through a per-user override. Next, On for everyone. One command through the production-task CLI turns the gate on, for example `prod-task shop-ai:on`. Finally, Kept with a kill switch. Every live feature keeps a named off switch, such as `prod-task shop-ai:off`, and AGENTS.md lists it beside the feature.

checks.name: no part of the system prompt

judge.reason: Every claim in the answer, including the four steps, the example commands and the AGENTS.md listing, is stated in the cited essay section.
